newsitem.title: UK: Camelot in ad campaign aimed at "opinion formers".
newsitem.headline: Camelot in ad campaign aimed at "opinion formers".

text.p: Camelot, operator of the British National Lottery, has launched a one-week newspaper advertising campaign, aimed at "opinion formers" and trumpeting the lottery's contributions to good causes and Camelot's own organisational abilities.

"General Election this Saturday," read the full-page ad that debuted on January 5 in the Sunday Times and Sunday Telegraph, followed on Monday by its appearance in the Guardian, Evening Standard and Scotland's Herald.
"Running the National Lottery is like organising a General Election every Saturday," began the copy block that ran under the headline.

A second ad, which debuted on Tuesday and will run through Saturday, was headlined, "We may have had our critics, but now the whole world's behind us." The ad highlights Camelot's lead position in contributing to good causes compared to other national lotteries. The ad, which Camelot had previously run in early November, is appearing in papers including the Financial Times, Times, Scotsman and Belfast Telegraph.
Camelot is not running these corporate message ads in Britain's many tabloid newspapers.
"It's really aimed at opinion formers," a Camelot spokeswoman told Reuters.

The ads are part of a corporate advertising campaign that Camelot launched last June. "Most of the advertising to date has been consumer ads, promoting the national lottery brand and encouraging people to play," the spokeswoman said.

The corporate ad campaign, however, is designed to promote Camelot's success as a lottery operator. "What we hope to achieve is to demonstrate what it takes to run the world's largest and most successful lottery -- the skills, the expertise and level of commitment needed," the spokeswoman said.

The spokeswoman, who declined to detail advertising spending, said the ads were not in response to the intense criticism and controversey that have surrounded the lottery since its launch in November 1994.
Camelot is a consortium owned by Cadbury Schweppes Plc , De La Rue Plc, Racal Electronics Plc , GTECH Holdings Corp and ICL.
